A blood-rose meadow sprawling across the foreground, deep-crimson petals the size of dinner plates carpeting every inch of scorched black soil.
A glass-bamboo grove occupying the midground, translucent jade-green stalks catching the light and scattering prismatic fragments across the forest floor.
A titan-mushroom forest dominating the entire frame, rust-orange caps each the diameter of a village square casting absolute shadow on the mossy understory.
A frost-flower field stretching from foreground to horizon, white crystalline blooms no taller than a knee glittering like shattered porcelain under grey winter sky.
A phosphorescent-tree forest filling the midground, silver-blue trunks pulsing with cold inner light that turns the surrounding fog into luminous milk.
An ember-thorn thicket massed in the foreground, coal-black branches threaded with veins of living orange fire reaching outward like grasping skeletal hands.
A floating-lotus marsh spread across the midground, enormous pale-gold blossoms the width of longboats drifting on black mirror-still water.
A corpse-flower stand clustered in the shadowed understory, mottled purple-and-grey blooms each taller than a man exhaling visible dark vapor into the still air.
A sky-vine drift tangled across the upper third of frame, rope-thick green-and-gold vines hanging from unseen heights and swaying without any wind present.
A glacier-lichen cliff face filling the entire background, pale turquoise and ash-white lichen colonies spread across vertical rock in continent-shaped patches.
A sacred-oak ring occupying the midground center, silver-barked ancient trees the width of towers arranged in a perfect circle around a sunlit clearing.
A dune-grass plain sweeping from foreground to the base of red sandstone cliffs, pale amber blades rippling in synchronized waves like breathing skin.
A kelp-canopy forest filling the upper water column, bronze-green fronds thirty meters tall forming a cathedral ceiling above the dim blue seafloor.
An ice-rose tundra blanketing the foreground, translucent blush-pink blooms frozen mid-petal-unfurl pushing through cracked permafrost in dense scattered clusters.
A fungal-creep forest consuming the midground, grey-purple mycelium threads weaving between blackened dead trunks and bulging into fist-sized nodes at every joint.
A midnight-iris field filling the entire foreground, blue-black petals edged with faint silver catching the moonlight across an absolutely flat expanse.
A crystal-bloom cluster erupting from a rock shelf in the foreground, white and rose-quartz blossoms faceted like gemstones growing in dense upward-reaching spires.
A world-tree rising from the far distant midground, a single ash-grey trunk so immense its lowest branches form their own cloud layer above the foothills.
A wisp-lily marsh spreading through the understory, thumbnail-sized yellow-white blooms floating on black water and each trailing a slow ribbon of golden light.
An ash-flower field extending from foreground to smoking horizon, grey-white blooms with char-black stems growing in perfect rows from still-warm volcanic soil.
A mangrove-on-stilts thicket massing in the foreground shallows, dark-mahogany prop roots arching six meters high forming an interlocked maze above green-black water.
A spirit-pine grove occupying the wind-swept midground, silver-needled trees trailing long scarves of luminous white mist from every branch in absolute silence.
A mirage-flower field shimmering across the sun-blasted foreground, translucent amber blossoms appearing and dissolving and reappearing with each ripple of heat haze.
A glow-mushroom carpet covering the entire foreground floor, thumbnail-scale violet-and-cyan caps packed so densely the ground itself appears to breathe soft blue light.
A cherry-blossom cloud massing in the upper midground, millions of soft-pink petals suspended at canopy height forming a solid rosy ceiling above the pale stone road.
